channel.title: Capital goods & infra · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Capital goods & infra in Indian markets. Today: tailwind (+1.7).

item.title: [+1] India, Egypt To Work On Terms Of Reference For Potential Trade Pact
item.description:
Signal: trade deal or tariff relief for India (India). 28 reports from Firstpost, DD News, The Times of India and 21 more. Related: “India-US trade deal: A 21-month timeline of negotiations and where things stand now”. Ongoing: also reported on 4 of the previous 7 days (first 12 Nov).

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Engineering exports gain access

Why it matters: Lower tariffs or a trade deal open markets for Indian exporters and attract investment into export manufacturing.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] Silver Falls Below $50: Hawkish Fed Bets, Rising Yields And Dollar Trigger Fresh Selloff
item.description:
Signal: lower metal prices. 3 reports from FXEmpire, TradingView, Investing.com India. Related: “Silver Falls As A Stronger Dollar And Rising Treasury Yields Fuel Fed Hike Bets By Kedia Advisory”. Turn: earlier readings (12 Nov) pointed the other way.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Input costs ease

Why it matters: Falling metal prices cut Indian producers' realisations, often on weak Chinese demand, while easing input costs for manufacturers.

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Trade war in focus at ASEAN summit ahead of Trump arrival
item.description:
Signal: global trade barriers (global). 1 report from The New Indian Express. Ongoing: also reported on 1 of the previous 7 days (first 13 Nov).

Capital goods & infra: mild headwind (−1) — Slower world trade

Why it matters: Tariff escalation between major economies slows world trade and demand for Indian exports, though some supply chains may shift towards India.

Market gauges: Growth outlook −1

Confidence: low · horizon: months

item.title: [+1] India's Exports Soar to Record $50B in Oct, Driven by Policy
item.description:
Signal: stronger Indian growth data (India). 2 reports from Rediff MoneyWiz, A2Z Taxcorp LLP. Related: “India's Exports Record Strong Growth of 29.90% in October 2026; Merchandise Exports Rise to US$ 49.47 Billion”. Mixed: 1 report points the other way. New in the last 24 hours.

Capital goods & infra: mild tailwind (+1) — Orders and capex firm

Why it matters: Better activity data points to firmer demand, orders and credit growth, supporting earnings across cyclical sectors.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +3, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: low · horizon: weeks
